title: 沙盒桥
summary: 宿主按固定字段顺序接住沙盒流：样式没写完前只留占位，高度只采用沙盒报上来且被钳制的数字，回传只放行校验过的 sendPrompt 与 openLink。
summaryEn: The host consumes a sandbox stream in a fixed field order: placeholders until CSS is complete, height only from a clamped sandbox report, and callbacks only for schema-checked sendPrompt and openLink.
asks: iframe 沙盒一边生成一边送到宿主时，字段怎样依次渲染、高度怎样跟着内容走、不合法的回传怎样被拦住？
asksEn: As an iframe sandbox streams into the host, how do fields render in order, how does height follow the content, and how are illegal callbacks refused?

links.when: 沙盒桥按固定字段拼一份隔离文档，不是话轮上的增量打字
links.whenEn: the bridge assembles an isolated document in a fixed field order, not turn-by-turn tokens

links.when: 占位句只持续到 css 完成，之后必须让出预览，不是一块一直占着的骨架
links.whenEn: placeholder lines last only until css completes, then the preview must take over

links.when: 回传是沙盒里两个白名单函数，不是助手壳该放在页面哪一侧
links.whenEn: callbacks are two whitelisted sandbox functions, not where an assistant shell sits
